subject: Procurement path & PR creation for Redwood POC

Subject: Procurement path & PR creation for Redwood POC

Hi Maria — thanks for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so procurement has a clear path: 

Summary of commercial paths we discussed:
- Credit card: fastest for small pilots (usually < $7.5k at Acme based on your note)
- Purchase Order (PR -> PO): standard enterprise flow for larger pilots / committed capacity
- Marketplace (e.g., AWS Marketplace): possible if your procurement prefers marketplace billing and procurement already supports it

Procurement questions for you / the procurement team:
- Do you use Coupa, Ariba, or a different vendor onboarding flow?
- What is your PR threshold (what dollar amount triggers a PR vs card)?
- Will procurement require a vendor onboarding packet (W-9, insurance cert, vendor questionnaire)?
- Do you have an internal supplier ID already for Redwood? If not, what is the expected lead time for supplier onboarding?

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) If you confirm Coupa/Ariba and procurement contact, we’ll provide a concise vendor packet (W-9, sample SOW, pricing breakdown) and a PR checklist.
2) We’ll open an internal Redwood ops ticket to ensure correct supplier-id mapping and prepare PO templates tied to deal RDW-2026-0943.
3) If you prefer marketplace, we’ll surface the pricing and enablement steps.

Attached: Redwood_PR_Guide_v1.pdf — short PR checklist and sample fields we’ve seen procurement ask for.

If you can loop in your procurement lead (or reply with procurement@ alias) we’ll get the onboarding started today.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni

- We use Coupa for vendor onboarding and PRs.
- Our internal threshold for a PR is $7,500; purchases below that often go on corporate card.
- Procurement will need the vendor onboarding form, W-9, and an insurance certificate.
- We don’t have a Redwood supplier ID yet. Typical lead time to get a supplier number is ~5–7 business days once the form is submitted (can be faster with the correct docs).

I’ve looped in procurement@acme-corp.com. I attached the Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx they use internally — please complete the vendor-side fields and return to procurement. Procurement: the contact is Patricia Lin.

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-15T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood — Coupa/Ariba PR & supplier onboarding checklist

Hi Patricia / Acme procurement team — I’m Laura on the Redwood operations team; looping in to make the supplier onboarding and PR creation as frictionless as possible. Below is a concise checklist mapped to the typical Coupa flow we’ve worked with customers on.

Coupa supplier onboarding & PR creation (recommended steps):
1) Supplier request submission (Acme) — fields we’ll provide: legal name, DBA, address, tax ID, remittance address, bank ACH details, contact info for billing and technical POCs.
2) Procurement returns supplier ID to Redwood. We request the numeric supplier ID to be included in the PR.
3) Create PR referencing deal: include RDW-2026-0943 in the PR justification text and attach the SOW (PDF).
4) Attach vendor docs to supplier record: W-9, certificate of insurance (COI), completed Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx.
5) Select PO payment terms and GL account; note that if Acme requires special legal terms we’ll route through your legal/procurement redline process.

Mapping notes (fields we commonly see needing explicit mapping):
- Coupa field "Supplier Number" -> Redwood supplier ID (required to close PO)
- Coupa "Invoice To" -> billing@redwood.com (we’ll accept invoices to that address)
- PO "Notes / justification" -> include deal id RDW-2026-0943 and SOW file name

Estimated SLA once vendor packet is submitted: 3–7 business days for supplier ID assignment; PR creation depends on internal approvals but often same day to 5 business days.

I’ve opened internal ticket ITX-43321 to ensure the vendor bank/W-9 info is staged for procurement intake and that finance can validate payment routing once supplier ID is issued.

Attachments: Coupa_PR_Steps.txt (step-by-step), internal reference: ITX-43321

If you confirm the required docs (W-9, COI, Vendor_Onboarding_Form) we’ll return the completed packet today. Happy to jump on a 15-minute call to walk through the Coupa upload if helpful.

Thanks — Laura Bennett
Ops Lead, Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
